test a different weighted scheme (softmax_neg_error) to see if it improves over inverse_error given moderate ranking stability and trend-dominated regime.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.4024. Series context: trend strength 0.95 and seasonal strength 0.134; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.329); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 7.481.
